name: skipjack
description: Skip the pitch. A browser extension that skips sponsor reads, interaction reminders, and self-promotion baked into videos.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.e2e: npm run build && node test/e2e/detect.mjs && node test/e2e/sponsorblock.mjs
scripts.e2e:edge: npm run build && node test/e2e/detect.mjs --edge && node test/e2e/sponsorblock.mjs --edge
scripts.e2e:chrome: npm run build && node test/e2e/detect.mjs --chrome && node test/e2e/sponsorblock.mjs --chrome
scripts.e2e:firefox: npm run build && node test/e2e/detect.mjs --firefox && node test/e2e/sponsorblock.mjs --firefox
